title: Architectural Refactoring Spec: Targeted Invariant-Guarded Decoupling Strategy
high_level_intent: Pragmatic refactoring with invariant enforcement: refactor the focal hub into clean decoupled interfaces while preserving public caller contracts.
developer_cognitive_context: Validates original developer intent for simple ergonomics while lifting historical compromises into explicit, invariant-guarded contracts.

architectural_invariants.rule: Domain entities must not directly import or invoke database / storage adapters.
architectural_invariants.verification_heuristic: Check AST imports of core modules for storage/db dependencies.

architectural_invariants.rule: State transitions must remain atomic and preserve immutability or lock protection.
architectural_invariants.verification_heuristic: Verify that mutations occur within atomic block or return new instances.

architectural_invariants.rule: Public method signatures on caller interfaces must maintain backward compatibility.
architectural_invariants.verification_heuristic: Verify parameter names and default values match previous AST signature.

execution_directives.instruction: Define a clean abstraction protocol 'ExecutionProtocol' with standard execute() method to decouple upstream callers from direct service implementation.
Refactor 'api_gateway.py' to inherit or implement ExecutionProtocol. Wrap any direct persistence calls into an injected or encapsulated adapter. Validate state preconditions before execution.
postconditions: 'api_gateway.py' implements protocol and passes AST validation without direct DB calls

execution_directives.instruction: Implement automated test suite verifying that INV-001 (clean layer boundaries) and INV-003 (backward compatibility) are strictly satisfied.
postconditions: Test passes when executed by test runner

verification_gates.criteria: All modified and newly created files must compile to valid Python AST without syntax errors.
Core domain files must have zero direct imports of persistence or external HTTP libraries.
Automated invariant tests must execute with zero failures or regressions.
